# Third-party notices

- `names.js` contains the first-name and surname lists from [Life-Simulator1](https://github.com/fungamer2-2/Life-Simulator1), commit `46d69c02b1196a4e01b8dbc1a1cf107a7252a107`. `lifesim-catalog.js` includes its country, book and movie lists, conversation, compliment and insult dialogue, activity sayings, music artists, pet names, breeds, pet activities and family outing ideas. The browser game also adapts some trait, school, scholarship, child progression and mortality, surviving co-parent succession, sibling and family sudden-death mechanics, child partner profiles and relationship interest, pregnancy, relationship interactions, engagement and weddings, health, karma, lottery, plastic surgery, student loans, work hours, stress, raise-request, progressive tax, career pension and kidnapping concepts with different rules and balancing. Its MIT copyright and permission notice is in `life-simulator1/LICENSE`.
- The selectable diet feature and diet categories, degree and job names, interview questions, promotion titles, life statistics, additional illness names, two book entries, outing dialogue, vehicle and property names and depreciation, and banking, market and will concepts are adapted and rebalanced from [OpenLife](https://codeberg.org/OpenLife/OpenLife), commit `9034077e32`. Its MIT copyright and permission notice is in `openlife/LICENSE`.

The projects are Python console applications. Their full codebases have not been included or ported into the browser game. Robert1811's life-simulator repository has no license file or GitHub license metadata as of this change; it was used for gameplay inspiration only, not copied.
